source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The assigned patch bypasses legacy FolderCache work when the Panorama startup preference is enabled and gives several direct entrypoints explicit NOT_IMPLEMENTED results. GetFolderCache also clears its out pointer. Non-Panorama behavior remains. The full Bug and review explain why wholesale removal was rejected: the legacy per-folder database may still need the cache on profiles with many folders. Repeated guards intentionally expose the boundary; they are not evidence of measured overhead or a general preference-check style rule. An assertion alone is not a release-mode guard. Static source inspection only.
title: Panorama disables the legacy FolderCache without removing the legacy path
